summary: Official Karimnagar Survey & Land Records custody and Telangana public Bhu Bharati/TGRAC land-survey channels were evidenced. TGRAC metadata exposes a polygon layer named Cadastral Parcels, but no usable anonymous Karimnagar parcel feature response was retrieved; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Telugu discovery queries are recorded in city-10073-karimnagar.json with actual first-party result URLs.
requestOutcomes: The official Karimnagar department page and TGRAC Web GIS catalogue were accessible. TGRAC Cadastral Parcels metadata was inspected and identified polygon geometry, projected CRS, and candidate native fields. The Bhu Bharati GIS page was found but its current fetch returned an internal error; the bounded exact-point ArcGIS query was inaccessible and local curl also encountered DNS timeout. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS exception was used.
